title: Windowed configuration core code
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, and let $C$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine on $x$. For a natural number $B$, its windowed core code consists of its optional state and input-head position, together with the work-tape contents restricted to positions $-B$ through $B$ and the work-tape head positions encoded in a range of size $2B+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $C$ of a $k$-tape machine on $x$
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the exact position encoding used for the work-tape head positions.
